يستنزفون (form X)
# يَسْتَنْزِفُونَ (yastanzifūna) /jas.tan.zi.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْزَفَ (istanzafa)
# يُسْتَنْزَفُونَ (yustanzafūna) /jus.tan.za.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْزَفَ (istanzafa)
